# duploai_admin_workspace (Data Source)

Fetches a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk workspace by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a workspace by ID.
data "duploai_admin_workspace" "example" {
  id = "<workspace-id>"
}

output "name" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_workspace.example.name
}

output "short_name" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_workspace.example.short_name
}

output "persona_ids" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_workspace.example.persona_ids
}

output "scope_ids" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_workspace.example.scope_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_ids` (List of String) IDs of the agents assigned to this workspace.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the workspace was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the workspace.
- `incident_ids` (List of String) IDs of the incidents assigned to this workspace.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the workspace is active.
- `knowledge_ids` (List of String) IDs of the knowledge bases assigned to this workspace.
- `name` (String) Name of the workspace.
- `persona_ids` (List of String) IDs of the personas assigned to this workspace.
- `project_ids` (List of String) IDs of the projects assigned to this workspace.
- `scope_ids` (List of String) IDs of the scopes assigned to this workspace.
- `short_name` (String) Short identifier for the workspace.
- `ticket_ids` (List of String) IDs of the tickets assigned to this workspace.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the workspace was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `version` (Number) Version counter, incremented on each update.
